runtime_prompt_en:
A fashion editorial photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties pausing on a temporary photography set inside a glass-roofed transit concourse in late afternoon after a short rain. Use the attached portrait only as guidance for visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob with airy bangs, softly rounded facial contours, dark eyes and natural glossy lips. She stands upright on the level floor with her torso facing the camera, adjusting the brass tilt knob on the side yoke of a vintage spotlight at shoulder height with her right hand; the lamp stands beside her, and her left arm hangs comfortably beside her hip. Her deep-teal opaque fitted cropped bodice covers the bust and ends below the ribcage. A black fine-mesh extension spans a bounded region of abdominal skin between the opaque bodice hem and the low-rise opaque trouser waistband. Individual fine mesh threads and open cells remain visible over the skin beneath. Her real navel is a small anatomical depression clearly readable through the mesh, below the bodice hem and above the trouser waistband. The opaque cotton-sateen bodice and trousers have continuous solid surfaces, seam contours and natural folds contrasting with the transparent abdominal mesh. Her face is calm and attentive, angled slightly toward the lamp while remaining readable. Frame her from the full head to upper thighs at chest height, almost frontal, with the hand and lamp entirely to the side of the abdominal panel. Repeating roof arches form a quiet symmetrical backdrop; a shallow reflection of them crosses the damp stone floor. Soft daylight reveals the mesh texture and skin relief, while the warm spotlight housing provides a restrained amber accent. Across her waist, an interconnected mesh pattern remains visible across the adult abdominal panel; the abdominal skin surface remains visible through that same mesh's openings. The attached opaque garment panels retain continuous edges beside the mesh region.

Avoid: unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, excessive HDR, illustration look, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, 3D render look, broken facial features, body distortion, cartoon style
